title: Refund proration by largest remainder
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the leftover distribution as favouring early lines on ties. That deterministic tie-break is stated in the contract; exact proportional shares in integer cents are impossible in general, and largest-remainder with a fixed tie-break keeps the parts summing exactly to the refund while staying reproducible.
